title: Property Paralegal
description:
Property Paralegal
- Job Type: Full-time
- Location: Surrey
- Salary: £25,000 - £28,000 per annum

A well-established law firm is seeking a Property Paralegal to join its busy property team. This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated individual looking to build their career in property law within a supportive and professional environment. The Property Paralegal will assist with a broad range of matters and play a key role in supporting fee earners with the smooth progression of files.

Day-to-day of the role
- Assisting with a range of residential property matters from instruction through to completion
- Preparing legal documents, forms and correspondence accurately and efficiently
- Opening, maintaining and closing client files in line with compliance procedures
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents, lenders and other third parties
- Carrying out searches, Land Registry applications and document checks
- Supporting fee earners with post-completion work and general case administration
- Monitoring key dates, deadlines and file progress to ensure matters move forward promptly
- Responding to client queries in a professional and timely manner
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring all documentation is up to date

Required Skills & Qualifications
- Law Degree 2:1 or higher
- Previous experience in a paralegal or legal support role within property law
- Good understanding of residential conveyancing processes and documentation
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a busy workload
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a wider team
- Confident using case management systems and Microsoft Office
- A proactive and professional approach to client service

Benefits
- Competitive salary of circa £25,000 - £28,000
- Opportunity to develop within a respected legal environment
- Exposure to a varied caseload within property law
- Supportive team culture and ongoing training
- Clear opportunity for career progression

How to apply

To apply for this Property Paralegal position, please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why this opportunity is of interest to you to Mark Watts at Reed, your local, friendly highly experienced legal recruitment manager.
